title: Rural Home Loans Payment Relief Options: Recast and Forbearance Terms
content:
Product terms for the two Rural Home Loans payment-relief options: recasting the monthly payment after a large curtailment, and hardship forbearance.

## Terms defined

- **Recast offered** — whether the monthly payment may be recast after a large curtailment (yes or no).
- **Recast minimum curtailment** — smallest single curtailment that qualifies for a recast, USD; 0 means not offered.
- **Recast fee** — fee per recast, USD.
- **Months per plan** — most months one forbearance plan may cover.
- **Lifetime forbearance months** — most forbearance months over the life of the loan.
- **Payments made before forbearance** — monthly payments that must have been made since closing before forbearance is available.

## Options grid

| Product | Recast offered | Recast minimum curtailment (USD) | Recast fee (USD) | Months per plan | Lifetime forbearance months | Payments made before forbearance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Country Home 15-Year Fixed | yes | 10000.00 | 250.00 | 3 | 6 | 6 |
| Country Home 20-Year Fixed | yes | 10000.00 | 250.00 | 3 | 6 | 6 |
| Country Home 30-Year Fixed | yes | 10000.00 | 250.00 | 3 | 6 | 6 |
| Country Home 5/6 Adjustable | no | 0 | 0 | 3 | 6 | 6 |
| Country Home 7/6 Adjustable | no | 0 | 0 | 3 | 6 | 6 |
| Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | yes | 25000.00 | 350.00 | 3 | 6 | 12 |

## Points of reading

- A single curtailment of 10000.00 USD meets the recast minimum on the three shorter fixed products; one of 9999.99 USD does not. On the Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed the minimum is 25000.00 USD.
- The Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed requires 12 payments made before forbearance, against 6 on the other products; plan and lifetime limits are the same on all six.
